slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month or whether purchased units are available for sale in the same month; its READY_TO_MODEL merely assumes a stock balance using current-month purchases.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases made in month t are available for sale in that same month, so ending stock equals prior ending stock plus current-month purchases minus current-month sales.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about purchase timing within the month, and the user did not confirm it; the agent nevertheless adopted this inventory balance and sales-limit logic in READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 purchase-timing slot remained unresolved; it had only assumed the timing in the final summary.

summary: The agent asked several boundary questions but never asked about the key hidden purchase-timing fact; it then assumed same-month availability of purchased goods in its READY_TO_MODEL summary, making the stop premature for a P1 slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
